title: macroframe
summary: MSUI has a macro window (Program.Macro.cs): 384x512 shell with MacroFrame-BotLeft/BotRight + MacroFrame-Icon art, an 18-slot icon grid with selection ring, name and multi-line body editors, New/Delete/Run/Exit buttons, drag-from-grid to the action bar, double-click-to-run, and persistence to macros.json. Macro icons are auto-derived from the body (#cast/#use spell/item lookup) rather than picked.

openItems.text: No name/icon picker popup (the reference MacroPopup: 20-icon paged grid + name editbox on Okay/Cancel) - macros are created in place and the icon cannot be chosen
No General vs Character-specific tab split (reference: two tabbed macro sets; MSUI has one flat 18-slot set)
No scrollbar on the body editor (reference MacroFrameScrollFrame)
Macro execution supports only a small command subset, with 'Unsupported macro command' chat fallback (engine scope, noted for honesty)
No open/close/save sounds (reference keeps igCharacterInfoOpen/Close, gsTitleOptionOK)
